lede: Shawnee does Christmas in two places: Downtown Shawnee on Johnson Drive, where the Mayor's Christmas Tree Lighting happens, and Shawnee Mission Park, where a holiday tree glows every night and a stage show runs in December.
celebrates: The City of Shawnee lists the Mayor's Christmas Tree Lighting at Downtown Shawnee, 11110 Johnson Drive, with live performances and local vendors. Johnson County Park and Recreation District adds its own holiday tree light display at John Barkley Plaza in Shawnee Mission Park, 7900 Renner Road, which the district says can be seen every night. Indoors, the district runs Theatre in the Park, which stages Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer in December, and the Mill Creek Activity Center hosts a Candy Cane Hunt for children ages 5 and under. Together these give Shawnee families a downtown evening, a park visit and a theater outing within one city.

faq: Where is the Shawnee Christmas tree lighting?

The City of Shawnee lists its Mayor's Christmas Tree Lighting at Downtown Shawnee, 11110 Johnson Drive. The city calendar describes live performances and local vendors as part of the evening. Check the city calendar for the current year's time, since it can change from year to year, and arrive early to find parking along Johnson Drive.
Can we see Christmas lights in Shawnee Mission Park?

Johnson County Park and Recreation District says its holiday tree light display at John Barkley Plaza, 7900 Renner Road, can be seen every night. The tree is part of the park's regular holiday display, so you do not need a ticket to look, and it pairs well with a Theatre in the Park show nearby.
Is there a Christmas show for kids in Shawnee?

Yes. Theatre in the Park, run by the district in Shawnee Mission Park, stages Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer from December 5 through 23, 2026. Some Saturdays include an 11 am show that suits younger children. Check the theatre page for ticket prices before choosing a date.
Is there a Santa visit for toddlers?

Johnson County Park and Recreation District holds a Candy Cane Hunt for children ages 5 and under with a parent on December 14 at Mill Creek Activity Center, with a craft, a snack and a prize. Pre-registration is required, so sign up on the district page. Family Tree Nursery also has a free Santa visit on December 13.
